clues.title: Water-Warped Missing Poster
clues.text: A flyer stapled to the greenhouse noticeboard, curled soft from humidity. 'HAVE YOU SEEN' a third-year named Tomas Reyes. Last seen near the lake path. Someone's added a hand-drawn bell next to his photo in pencil, then tried to erase it.

clues.title: Junie's Corkboard Theory
clues.text: Junie's own corkboard, half photography contact sheets and half conspiracy string. A sticky note in her handwriting: 'ok NOT saying it's the lake but it's kind of always the lake.'

clues.title: Overheard: Two Third-Years
clues.text: "...third one this term." "My cousin said the bell rang the night before, actually rang, not the clock chime." "Don't say that near a teacher, you'll get the talk."

clues.title: Junie's Lake Contact Sheet
clues.text: A page of thumbnail photos, mostly out of focus, all shot from the greenhouse's back window: the lake path at dusk, three separate evenings. In the corner of one frame, blurred, someone standing very still.
